description: This file defines a Spring Batch Tasklet class 'ApplyHolidaysToLoansTasklet' responsible for applying holiday adjustments to loan repayment schedules within the Apache Fineract platform. It processes holidays, adjusts repayment dates accordingly, and triggers relevant business events.

classes.name: ApplyHolidaysToLoansTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch Tasklet for applying holiday adjustments to loan repayment schedules in Fineract.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked by Spring Batch to process holidays and adjust loan repayment schedules.

methods.name: applyHolidayToRepaymentScheduleDates
methods.description: Adjusts loan repayment schedule dates based on a holiday, rescheduling as necessary.

methods.name: isRepaymentScheduleAdjustmentNeeded
methods.description: Checks if repayment schedule adjustment is needed based on the adjusted date.

methods.name: adjustRepaymentSchedules
methods.description: Adjusts individual repayment schedule installments based on a holiday.

methods.name: adjustAllRepaymentSchedules
methods.description: Adjusts all repayment installments of a loan in response to a holiday.

methods.name: getNextRepaymentDate
methods.description: Calculates the next repayment date considering holiday multiple adjustments.

methods.name: doStandardMonthlyCheck
methods.description: Performs standard monthly check to determine adjusted repayment date.
